title: FIPS Cryptographic Inventory Entry
description: One cataloged cryptographic call site (or a documented absence of one) discovered during FIPS 140-3 Phase 1 cryptographic inventory scans. Produced by WO-005/WO-006/WO-007/WO-008/WO-009/WO-010/WO-011 and aggregated by WO-019.

file.description: Repository-relative path to the source file containing the call site. For entries where no source file exists (e.g. an engine that is not vendored in this repository), a descriptive placeholder string is used instead of a real path.

line_range.description: Line or inclusive line range in `file` covering the call site (e.g. "120-167" or "472"). Use the literal string "N/A" when `status` is not "found".

function.description: Enclosing Go function (or method, formatted as Receiver.Name) that contains the call site. Use "N/A" when `status` is not "found".

algorithm.description: Cryptographic algorithm or primitive exercised at this call site (e.g. "RSA-OAEP-SHA256", "HMAC-SHA256", "AES-256-GCM", "SHA-1"). Use "none" when `status` is not "found".

library.description: Go import path providing the primitive (e.g. "crypto/x509", "golang.org/x/crypto/bcrypt", "github.com/hashicorp/vault/helper/pkcs7"). For externalized/not-present engines, the pinned module path and version from go.mod.

security_relevant.description: True if this usage protects confidentiality, integrity, or authenticity of data or credentials (a Phase 2 remediation candidate if also fips_approved=false). False for non-security usages such as cache keys, content-addressing, or display fingerprints.

fips_approved.description: True if the algorithm is FIPS 140-3 Approved (per NIST SP 800-140C / current CMVP Approved list) as used here. False for non-Approved algorithms (e.g. MD5, SHA-1 for integrity, Ed25519, ChaCha20-Poly1305) or algorithms outside the scan's scope.

classification_rationale.description: Human-readable explanation of the security_relevant and fips_approved determination. Required to be specific to the call site, not a bulk statement (per FIPS-CRYPTO-002 anti-pattern rule: no bulk-flagging of MD5/SHA-1).

engine_or_method.description: The builtin secrets engine or auth method subdirectory this entry belongs to (e.g. "pki", "transit", "aws" (credential), "userpass").

status.description: found: a real call site verified at file:line_range. no_direct_imports: the engine/method has zero direct crypto imports in builtin/ (may still delegate to a third-party library — see notes). not_present_in_repo: the named engine has no source under builtin/ in this repository (externalized plugin module). cross_reference: the operation is cataloged in full in another inventory file; this entry only points to it. test_only: the call site exists only in a _test.go file and is excluded from security-relevance classification per WO-007 edge cases. Defaults to "found" when omitted.

test_only.description: True if the call site is in a _test.go file. Test-only call sites are cataloged for completeness but excluded from security-relevance classification.

cross_reference.description: Relative path (from fips/inventory/) to the inventory file that fully catalogs this call site, when status is "cross_reference".

notes.description: Optional free-text context: e.g. a transitively-included third-party dependency, a version caveat, or a pointer to related RFC/standard.
